cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a creative, resourceful, and collaborative laboratory scientist to join our medicinal chemistry team. The candidate will have a strong track record in organic synthesis and medicinal chemistry. The successful candidate will be responsible for the synthesis of small-molecule drug candidates and the analysis of diverse data sets to build structure-activity relationships (SAR) to help drive medicinal chemistry strategy. Experience in the design of new molecules to support SAR and advancement of projects, as well as structure-based design is a plus. We are looking for individuals who have a passion for drug-discovery.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Under general supervision, independently conduct multi-step synthesis of target molecules. Purify and characterize compounds using a variety of techniques including chromatography, crystallization, trituration, LCMS, NMR, etc. Independently design and optimize synthetic routes. Solve synthetic chemistry problems to enable access to new chemical space and novel IP. Champion the application of cutting-edge modern synthetic chemistry to enable efficient access to complex target molecules at both milligram and multi-gram scale. Efficiently analyze complex data sets to develop a deep understanding of SAR. Contribute to the design of new molecules to advance project goals. Productively interact with cross-functional scientists (e.g. Biology, structural biology, ADME/Tox) to advance project goals. Effectively communicate results and progress in both individual and multi-disciplinary team settings. Stay abreast of the literature in both synthetic organic chemistry and medicinal chemistry and proactively apply knowledge to support company research objectives. Contribute to the day to day running of the lab to ensure a smooth and safe operation. Maintain a safe working environment and adhere to all corporate lab safety standards. Assist in the preparation of patents and publications, as required. Maintain excellent record keeping, including updated and well-organized lab e-notebooks. Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ph.D. In synthetic organic or medicinal chemistry with 0-3 years of relevant industry experience.
Deep knowledge of modern synthetic chemistry and analytical techniques.
Experience in synthetic method development and target-oriented synthesis.
Strong track record of scientific innovation and problem solving as evidenced by peer-reviewed publications and/or patents.
Self-motivated with excellent interpersonal, organizational and communication skills.
Excellent oral and written communication skills, including accurate record keeping and preparation and delivery of presentations/reports.
Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
Ability to learn new concepts and skills that support primary responsibilities in lab.
Adaptable/Flexible - willing and able to adjust to multiple demands and shifting priorities as well as an ability to meet day-to-day challenges with confidence and professionalism.
Preferred Requirements
Academic post-doctoral experience in synthetic/medicinal chemistry.
Experience with chemical biology, structure-based drug design, and/or medicinal chemistry.

cond_0020.intro: We are looking for a creative, resourceful, and highly collaborative laboratory scientist to join our medicinal chemistry team. The candidate will have a strong track record in both cutting edge organic synthesis/ medicinal chemistry, with a demonstrated ability to thrive and contribute in a multi-disciplinary fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for the synthesis of small-molecule drug candidates and the analysis of diverse data sets to build structure-activity relationships (SAR) to help drive medicinal chemistry strategy. Proficiency/ experience in the design of new molecules to support SAR and advancement of projects, as well as structure-based design is a plus. We are looking for individuals who have a passion for drug-discovery.

Effectively communicate results and progress in both individual and multi-disciplinary team settings. Stay abreast of the literature in both synthetic organic chemistry and medicinal chemistry and proactively apply knowledge to support company research objectives. Contribute to the day to day running of the lab to ensure a smooth and safe operation. Maintain a safe working environment and adhere to all corporate lab safety standards. Assist in the preparation of patents and publications, as required. Maintain excellent record keeping, including updated and well-organized lab e-notebooks. Perform other duties as assigned.

Ph.D. In synthetic organic or medicinal chemistry required; advanced degree with relevant industry experience strongly preferred.

Exceptional interpersonal, organizational, and communication skills, including accurate record keeping and preparation and delivery of presentations/reports.

Academic post-doctoral experience in synthetic/medicinal chemistry.

The successful candidate will be responsible for the synthesis of small-molecule drug candidates and the analysis of diverse data sets to build structure-activity relationships (SAR) to help drive medicinal chemistry strategy. Proficiency and experience in the design of new molecules to support SAR and advancement of projects, as well as structure-based design is a plus. We are looking for individuals who have a passion for drug-discovery. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of synthetic chemistry problems and SAR data.
cond_0058.responsibilities: Under general supervision, independently conduct multi-step synthesis of target molecules. Purify and characterize compounds using a variety of techniques including chromatography, crystallization, trituration, LCMS, NMR, etc. Independently design and optimize synthetic routes. Solve synthetic chemistry problems to enable access to new chemical space and novel IP. Champion the application of cutting-edge modern synthetic chemistry to enable efficient access to complex target molecules at both milligram and multi-gram scale. Efficiently analyze complex data sets to develop a deep understanding of SAR. Contribute to the design of new molecules to advance project goals. Productively interact with cross-functional scientists (e.g. Biology, structural biology, ADME/Tox) to advance project goals. Effectively communicate results and progress in both individual and multi-disciplinary team settings. Stay abreast of the literature in both synthetic organic chemistry and medicinal chemistry and proactively apply knowledge to support company research objectives. Contribute to the day to day running of the lab to ensure a smooth and safe operation. Maintain a safe working environment and adhere to all corporate lab safety standards. Assist in the preparation of patents and publications, as required. Maintain excellent record keeping, including updated and well-organized lab e-notebooks. Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0058.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ph.D. In synthetic organic or medicinal chemistry with 0-3 years of relevant industry experience.
Strong track record of scientific innovation and problem solving as evidenced by peer-reviewed publications and/or patents.
Deep knowledge of modern synthetic chemistry and analytical techniques.
Experience in synthetic method development and target-oriented synthesis.
Self-motivated with excellent interpersonal, organizational and communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
Excellent oral and written communication skills, including accurate record keeping and preparation and delivery of presentations and reports.
Preferred Requirements
Academic post-doctoral experience in synthetic or medicinal chemistry.
Experience with chemical biology, structure-based drug design, and/or medicinal chemistry.
Ability to learn new concepts and skills that support primary responsibilities in lab.
Adaptable and flexible — willing and able to adjust to multiple demands and shifting priorities, and able to meet day-to-day challenges with confidence and professionalism.

The candidate will have a strong track record in organic synthesis and medicinal chemistry, with demonstrated ability to contribute in a multi-disciplinary environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for the synthesis of small-molecule drug candidates and the analysis of diverse data sets to build structure-activity relationships (SAR) to help inform medicinal chemistry strategy. Experience in the design of new molecules to support SAR and advancement of projects, as well as structure-based design, is a plus. We are looking for individuals with a strong interest in drug discovery.
cond_0088.responsibilities:
Under general supervision, independently conduct multi-step synthesis of target molecules.
Purify and characterize compounds using a variety of techniques including chromatography, crystallization, trituration, LCMS, NMR, etc.
Independently design and optimize synthetic routes.
Solve synthetic chemistry problems to enable access to new chemical space and novel IP.
Apply modern synthetic chemistry methods to enable efficient access to complex target molecules at both milligram and multi-gram scale.
Analyze complex data sets to develop a thorough understanding of SAR.
Contribute to the design of new molecules to advance project goals.
Coordinate with cross-functional scientists (e.g. Biology, structural biology, ADME/Tox) on specific project deliverables to advance project goals.
Document and share results and progress with relevant team members in both individual and multi-disciplinary team settings.
Keep current with the literature in synthetic organic chemistry and medicinal chemistry and apply relevant knowledge to support research objectives.
Contribute to the day to day running of the lab to ensure a smooth and safe operation.
Maintain a safe working environment and adhere to all corporate lab safety standards.
Assist in the preparation of patents and publications, as required.
Maintain excellent record keeping, including updated and well-organized lab e-notebooks.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0088.requirements:
Ph.D. In synthetic organic or medicinal chemistry required with 0-3 years of relevant industry experience.
Academic post-doctoral experience in synthetic/medicinal chemistry is a plus.
Strong track record of scientific innovation and problem solving as evidenced by peer-reviewed publications and/or patents.
Deep knowledge of modern synthetic chemistry and analytical techniques.
Experience in synthetic method development and target-oriented synthesis.
Experience with chemical biology, structure-based drug design, and/or medicinal chemistry is a plus.
Self-motivated with strong organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in a structured, execution-focused environment.
Ability to learn new concepts and skills that support primary responsibilities in the lab.
Strong written communication skills, including accurate record keeping and preparation of presentations and reports.
Able to adjust to multiple demands and shifting priorities, and to meet day-to-day challenges with professionalism.

cond_0110.intro: We are looking for a creative, resourceful, and highly collaborative laboratory scientist to join our medicinal chemistry team. The candidate will have a strong track record in both cutting edge organic synthesis/ medicinal chemistry, with a demonstrated ability to thrive and contribute in a multi-disciplinary fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for the synthesis of small-molecule drug candidates and the analysis of diverse data sets to build structure-activity relationships (SAR) to help drive medicinal chemistry strategy. Proficiency/ experience in the design of new molecules to support SAR and advancement of projects, as well as structure-based design is a plus. We are looking for individuals who have a passion for drug-discovery.
cond_0110.responsibilities: Under general supervision, independently conduct multi-step synthesis of target molecules. Purify and characterize compounds using a variety of techniques including chromatography, crystallization, trituration, LCMS, NMR, etc. Independently design and optimize synthetic routes. Solve synthetic chemistry problems to enable access to new chemical space and novel IP. Champion the application of cutting-edge modern synthetic chemistry to enable efficient access to complex target molecules at both milligram and multi-gram scale. Efficiently analyze complex data sets to develop a deep understanding of SAR. Contribute to the design of new molecules to advance project goals. Productively interact with cross-functional scientists (e.g. Biology, structural biology, ADME/Tox) to advance project goals. Effectively communicate results and progress in both individual and multi-disciplinary team settings. Stay abreast of the literature in both synthetic organic chemistry and medicinal chemistry and proactively apply knowledge to support company research objectives. Contribute to the day to day running of the lab to ensure a smooth and safe operation. Maintain a safe working environment and adhere to all corporate lab safety standards. Assist in the preparation of patents and publications, as required. Maintain excellent record keeping, including updated and well-organized lab e-notebooks. Perform other duties as assigned.

cond_0120.intro: We are looking for a creative, resourceful, and highly collaborative laboratory scientist to join our medicinal chemistry team. The candidate will have a strong track record in both cutting edge organic synthesis/ medicinal chemistry, with a demonstrated ability to thrive and contribute in a multi-disciplinary fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for the synthesis of small-molecule drug candidates and the analysis of diverse data sets to build structure-activity relationships (SAR) to help drive medicinal chemistry strategy. Proficiency/ experience in the design of new molecules to support SAR and advancement of projects, as well as structure-based design is a plus. We are looking for individuals who have a passion for drug-discovery.

Champion the application of cutting-edge modern synthetic chemistry to enable efficient access to complex target molecules at both milligram and multi-gram scale. Efficiently analyze complex data sets to develop a deep understanding of SAR. Contribute to the design of new molecules to advance project goals. Productively interact with cross-functional scientists (e.g. Biology, structural biology, ADME/Tox) to advance project goals. Effectively communicate results and progress in both individual and multi-disciplinary team settings. Stay abreast of the literature in both synthetic organic chemistry and medicinal chemistry and proactively apply knowledge to support company research objectives. Contribute to the day to day running of the lab to ensure a smooth and safe operation. Maintain a safe working environment and adhere to all corporate lab safety standards. Assist in the preparation of patents and publications, as required. Maintain excellent record keeping, including updated and well-organized lab e-notebooks. Perform other duties as assigned.

cond_0242.intro: We are looking for a creative and resourceful laboratory scientist to join our medicinal chemistry team. The candidate will have a strong track record in organic synthesis and medicinal chemistry. You will take ownership of the synthesis of small-molecule drug candidates and drive analysis of diverse data sets to build structure-activity relationships (SAR) and advance medicinal chemistry strategy.
cond_0242.responsibilities: Under general supervision, independently execute multi-step synthesis of target molecules. Purify and characterize compounds using techniques including chromatography, crystallization, trituration, LCMS, NMR, etc. Independently design and optimize synthetic routes. Solve synthetic chemistry problems to open access to new chemical space and novel IP. Champion the application of cutting-edge modern synthetic chemistry to deliver efficient access to complex target molecules at both milligram and multi-gram scale. Analyze complex data sets to develop a deep understanding of SAR. Lead the design of new molecules to advance project goals. Directly engage with cross-functional scientists (e.g. Biology, structural biology, ADME/Tox) to drive project goals forward. Communicate results and progress effectively in both individual and multi-disciplinary team settings. Stay current with literature in synthetic organic chemistry and medicinal chemistry and proactively apply knowledge to advance company research objectives. Take responsibility for day-to-day lab operations to ensure smooth and safe running. Maintain a safe working environment and adhere to all corporate lab safety standards. Contribute to the preparation of patents and publications, as required. Maintain excellent record keeping, including updated and well-organized lab e-notebooks. Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0242.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ph.D. In synthetic organic or medicinal chemistry with 0–3 years of relevant industry experience.
Deep knowledge of modern synthetic chemistry and analytical techniques.
Experience in synthetic method development and target-oriented synthesis.
Strong track record of scientific innovation and problem solving, as evidenced by peer-reviewed publications and/or patents.
Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and communication skills, including accurate record keeping and preparation and delivery of presentations/reports.
Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
Preferred Requirements
Academic post-doctoral experience in synthetic/medicinal chemistry.
Experience with chemical biology, structure-based drug design, and/or medicinal chemistry.
Ability to learn new concepts and skills that support primary lab responsibilities.
Adaptable and flexible — able to adjust to multiple demands and shifting priorities, and to meet day-to-day challenges with confidence and professionalism.

cond_0332.intro: We are looking for a creative and resourceful laboratory scientist to join our medicinal chemistry team. The candidate will have a strong track record in organic synthesis and medicinal chemistry. You will take ownership of the synthesis of small-molecule drug candidates and drive analysis of diverse data sets to build structure-activity relationships (SAR) and advance medicinal chemistry strategy.
cond_0332.responsibilities: Under general supervision, independently execute multi-step synthesis of target molecules. Purify and characterize compounds using techniques including chromatography, crystallization, trituration, LCMS, NMR, etc. Independently design and optimize synthetic routes. Solve synthetic chemistry problems to open access to new chemical space and novel IP. Champion the application of cutting-edge modern synthetic chemistry to deliver efficient access to complex target molecules at both milligram and multi-gram scale. Analyze complex data sets to develop a deep understanding of SAR. Lead the design of new molecules to advance project goals. Directly engage with cross-functional scientists (e.g. Biology, structural biology, ADME/Tox) to drive project goals forward. Communicate results and progress effectively in both individual and multi-disciplinary team settings. Stay current with literature in synthetic organic chemistry and medicinal chemistry and proactively apply knowledge to advance company research objectives. Take responsibility for day-to-day lab operations to ensure smooth and safe running. Maintain a safe working environment and adhere to all corporate lab safety standards. Contribute to the preparation of patents and publications, as required. Maintain excellent record keeping, including updated and well-organized lab e-notebooks. Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0332.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ph.D. In synthetic organic or medicinal chemistry with 0–3 years of relevant industry experience.
Deep knowledge of modern synthetic chemistry and analytical techniques.
Experience in synthetic method development and target-oriented synthesis.
Strong track record of scientific innovation and problem solving, as evidenced by peer-reviewed publications and/or patents.
Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and communication skills, including accurate record keeping and preparation and delivery of presentations/reports.
Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
Preferred Requirements
Academic post-doctoral experience in synthetic/medicinal chemistry.
Experience with chemical biology, structure-based drug design, and/or medicinal chemistry.
Ability to learn new concepts and skills that support primary lab responsibilities.
Adaptable and flexible — able to adjust to multiple demands and shifting priorities, and to meet day-to-day challenges with confidence and professionalism.

The candidate will have a strong track record in organic synthesis and medicinal chemistry, with demonstrated ability to contribute in a multi-disciplinary environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for the synthesis of small-molecule drug candidates and the analysis of diverse data sets to build structure-activity relationships (SAR) to help inform medicinal chemistry strategy. Experience in the design of new molecules to support SAR and advancement of projects, as well as structure-based design, is a plus. We are looking for individuals with a strong interest in drug discovery.
cond_0466.responsibilities:
Under general supervision, independently conduct multi-step synthesis of target molecules.
Purify and characterize compounds using a variety of techniques including chromatography, crystallization, trituration, LCMS, NMR, etc.
Independently design and optimize synthetic routes.
Solve synthetic chemistry problems to enable access to new chemical space and novel IP.
Apply modern synthetic chemistry methods to enable efficient access to complex target molecules at both milligram and multi-gram scale.
Analyze complex data sets to develop a thorough understanding of SAR.
Contribute to the design of new molecules to advance project goals.
Coordinate with cross-functional scientists (e.g. Biology, structural biology, ADME/Tox) on specific project deliverables to advance project goals.
Document and share results and progress with relevant team members in both individual and multi-disciplinary team settings.
Keep current with the literature in synthetic organic chemistry and medicinal chemistry and apply relevant knowledge to support research objectives.
Contribute to the day to day running of the lab to ensure a smooth and safe operation.
Maintain a safe working environment and adhere to all corporate lab safety standards.
Assist in the preparation of patents and publications, as required.
Maintain excellent record keeping, including updated and well-organized lab e-notebooks.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0466.requirements:
Ph.D. In synthetic organic or medicinal chemistry required with 0-3 years of relevant industry experience.
Academic post-doctoral experience in synthetic/medicinal chemistry is a plus.
Strong track record of scientific innovation and problem solving as evidenced by peer-reviewed publications and/or patents.
Deep knowledge of modern synthetic chemistry and analytical techniques.
Experience in synthetic method development and target-oriented synthesis.
Experience with chemical biology, structure-based drug design, and/or medicinal chemistry is a plus.
Self-motivated with strong organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in a structured, execution-focused environment.
Ability to learn new concepts and skills that support primary responsibilities in the lab.
Strong written communication skills, including accurate record keeping and preparation of presentations and reports.
Able to adjust to multiple demands and shifting priorities, and to meet day-to-day challenges with professionalism.

The candidate will have a strong track record in both cutting edge organic synthesis and medicinal chemistry. The successful candidate will be responsible for the synthesis of small-molecule drug candidates and the analysis of diverse data sets to build structure-activity relationships (SAR) to help drive medicinal chemistry strategy. Proficiency and experience in the design of new molecules to support SAR and advancement of projects, as well as structure-based design is a plus. We are looking for individuals who have a passion for drug-discovery.
cond_0496.responsibilities: Under general supervision, independently conduct multi-step synthesis of target molecules. Purify and characterize compounds using a variety of techniques including chromatography, crystallization, trituration, LCMS, NMR, etc. Independently design and optimize synthetic routes. Solve synthetic chemistry problems to enable access to new chemical space and novel IP. Champion the application of cutting-edge modern synthetic chemistry to enable efficient access to complex target molecules at both milligram and multi-gram scale. Efficiently analyze complex data sets to develop a deep understanding of SAR. Contribute to the design of new molecules to advance project goals. Productively interact with cross-functional scientists (e.g. Biology, structural biology, ADME/Tox) to advance project goals. Effectively communicate results and progress in both individual and multi-disciplinary team settings. Stay abreast of the literature in both synthetic organic chemistry and medicinal chemistry and proactively apply knowledge to support company research objectives. Contribute to the day to day running of the lab to ensure a smooth and safe operation. Maintain a safe working environment and adhere to all corporate lab safety standards. Assist in the preparation of patents and publications, as required. Maintain excellent record keeping, including updated and well-organized lab e-notebooks. Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0496.requirements:
Ph.D. In synthetic organic or medicinal chemistry required with 0-3 years of relevant industry experience.
Academic post-doctoral experience in synthetic/ medicinal chemistry is a plus.
Strong track record of scientific innovation and problem solving as evidenced by peer-reviewed publications and/or patents.
The candidate must exhibit a deep knowledge of modern synthetic chemistry and analytical techniques.
Experience in synthetic method development and target-oriented synthesis.
Experience with chemical biology, structure-based drug design, and/or medicinal chemistry is a plus.
Self-motivated with excellent interpersonal, organizational and communication skills.
Must be able to work effectively in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
Ability to learn new concepts and skills that support their primary responsibilities in lab.
Excellent oral and written communication skills, including accurate record keeping and preparation and delivery of presentations/ reports.
Adaptable/ Flexible - willing and able to adjust to multiple demands and shifting priorities as well as an ability to meet day-to-day challenges with confidence and professionalism.

The candidate will have a strong track record in both cutting edge organic synthesis/ medicinal chemistry, with a demonstrated ability to thrive and contribute in a multi-disciplinary fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for the synthesis of small-molecule drug candidates and the analysis of diverse data sets to build structure-activity relationships (SAR) to help drive medicinal chemistry strategy. Proficiency/ experience in the design of new molecules to support SAR and advancement of projects, as well as structure-based design is a plus. We are looking for individuals who have a passion for drug-discovery.
cond_0506.responsibilities: Under general supervision, independently conduct multi-step synthesis of target molecules. Purify and characterize compounds using a variety of techniques including chromatography, crystallization, trituration, LCMS, NMR, etc. Independently design and optimize synthetic routes. Solve synthetic chemistry problems to enable access to new chemical space and novel IP. Champion the application of cutting-edge modern synthetic chemistry to enable efficient access to complex target molecules at both milligram and multi-gram scale. Efficiently analyze complex data sets to develop a deep understanding of SAR. Contribute to the design of new molecules to advance project goals. Productively interact with cross-functional scientists (e.g. Biology, structural biology, ADME/Tox) to advance project goals. Effectively communicate results and progress in both individual and multi-disciplinary team settings. Stay abreast of the literature in both synthetic organic chemistry and medicinal chemistry and proactively apply knowledge to support company research objectives. Contribute to the day to day running of the lab to ensure a smooth and safe operation. Maintain a safe working environment and adhere to all corporate lab safety standards. Assist in the preparation of patents and publications, as required. Maintain excellent record keeping, including updated and well-organized lab e-notebooks. Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0506.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ph.D. In synthetic organic or medicinal chemistry required; advanced degree with relevant industry experience strongly preferred.
Proven track record of scientific innovation and problem solving as evidenced by peer-reviewed publications and/or patents.
Deep expertise in modern synthetic chemistry and analytical techniques.
Demonstrated expertise in synthetic method development and target-oriented synthesis.
Exceptional interpersonal, organizational, and communication skills, including accurate record keeping and preparation and delivery of presentations/reports.
Exceptional oral and written communication skills.
Preferred Requirements
Academic post-doctoral experience in synthetic/medicinal chemistry.
Proficiency in chemical biology, structure-based drug design, and/or medicinal chemistry.
Strong command of new concepts and skills that support primary responsibilities in the lab.
Proven ability to manage multiple demands and shifting priorities with confidence and professionalism.

The successful candidate will be responsible for the synthesis of small-molecule drug candidates and the analysis of diverse data sets to build structure-activity relationships (SAR) to help drive medicinal chemistry strategy. Proficiency/ experience in the design of new molecules to support SAR and advancement of projects, as well as structure-based design is a plus. We are looking for individuals who have a passion for drug-discovery. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of synthetic chemistry problems and SAR analysis.
cond_0517.responsibilities: Under general supervision, independently conduct multi-step synthesis of target molecules. Purify and characterize compounds using a variety of techniques including chromatography, crystallization, trituration, LCMS, NMR, etc. Independently design and optimize synthetic routes. Solve synthetic chemistry problems to enable access to new chemical space and novel IP. Champion the application of cutting-edge modern synthetic chemistry to enable efficient access to complex target molecules at both milligram and multi-gram scale. Efficiently analyze complex data sets to develop a deep understanding of SAR. Contribute to the design of new molecules to advance project goals. Productively interact with cross-functional scientists (e.g. Biology, structural biology, ADME/Tox) to advance project goals. Effectively communicate results and progress in both individual and multi-disciplinary team settings. Stay abreast of the literature in both synthetic organic chemistry and medicinal chemistry and proactively apply knowledge to support company research objectives. Contribute to the day to day running of the lab to ensure a smooth and safe operation. Maintain a safe working environment and adhere to all corporate lab safety standards. Assist in the preparation of patents and publications, as required. Maintain excellent record keeping, including updated and well-organized lab e-notebooks. Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0517.requirements:
Ph.D. In synthetic organic or medicinal chemistry required with 0-3 years of relevant industry experience.
Academic post-doctoral experience in synthetic/ medicinal chemistry is a plus.
Strong track record of scientific innovation and problem solving as evidenced by peer-reviewed publications and/or patents.
The candidate must exhibit a deep knowledge of modern synthetic chemistry and analytical techniques.
Experience in synthetic method development and target-oriented synthesis.
Experience with chemical biology, structure-based drug design, and/or medicinal chemistry is a plus.
Self-motivated with excellent interpersonal, organizational and communication skills.
Must be able to work effectively in a dynamic and collaborative, fast-paced environment.
Ability to learn new concepts and skills that support their primary responsibilities in lab.
Excellent oral and written communication skills, including accurate record keeping and preparation and delivery of presentations/ reports.
Adaptable/ Flexible - willing and able to adjust to multiple demands and shifting priorities as well as an ability to meet day-to-day challenges with confidence and professionalism.
cond_0517.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0517.workplace_support: Employees are supported through mentoring, development opportunities, and programming that helps them build skills, navigate challenges, and grow professionally over time.

The successful candidate will be responsible for the synthesis of small-molecule drug candidates and the analysis of diverse data sets to build structure-activity relationships (SAR) to help drive medicinal chemistry strategy. Experience in the design of new molecules to support SAR and advancement of projects, as well as structure-based design is a plus. We are looking for individuals who have a passion for drug-discovery.
cond_0613.responsibilities: Under general supervision, independently conduct multi-step synthesis of target molecules. Purify and characterize compounds using a variety of techniques including chromatography, crystallization, trituration, LCMS, NMR, etc. Independently design and optimize synthetic routes. Solve synthetic chemistry problems to enable access to new chemical space and novel IP. Champion the application of cutting-edge modern synthetic chemistry to enable efficient access to complex target molecules at both milligram and multi-gram scale. Efficiently analyze complex data sets to develop a deep understanding of SAR. Contribute to the design of new molecules to advance project goals. Productively interact with cross-functional scientists (e.g. Biology, structural biology, ADME/Tox) to advance project goals. Effectively communicate results and progress in both individual and multi-disciplinary team settings. Stay abreast of the literature in both synthetic organic chemistry and medicinal chemistry and proactively apply knowledge to support company research objectives. Contribute to the day to day running of the lab to ensure a smooth and safe operation. Maintain a safe working environment and adhere to all corporate lab safety standards. Assist in the preparation of patents and publications, as required. Maintain excellent record keeping, including updated and well-organized lab e-notebooks. Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0613.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ph.D. In synthetic organic or medicinal chemistry with 0-3 years of relevant industry experience.
Deep knowledge of modern synthetic chemistry and analytical techniques.
Experience in synthetic method development and target-oriented synthesis.
Strong track record of scientific innovation and problem solving as evidenced by peer-reviewed publications and/or patents.
Self-motivated with excellent interpersonal, organizational and communication skills.
Excellent oral and written communication skills, including accurate record keeping and preparation and delivery of presentations/reports.
Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
Ability to learn new concepts and skills that support primary responsibilities in lab.
Adaptable/Flexible - willing and able to adjust to multiple demands and shifting priorities as well as an ability to meet day-to-day challenges with confidence and professionalism.
Preferred Requirements
Academic post-doctoral experience in synthetic/medicinal chemistry.
Experience with chemical biology, structure-based drug design, and/or medicinal chemistry.
cond_0613.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
